entities.summary: The Communist Party of Kurdistan is a banned political party in Turkey, founded in 1982 as the Kurdish branch of the Communist Labour Party of Turkey (TKEP). Between 1980 and 1982, the TKEP had a Kurdistan Autonomous Organization. In 1990, the KKP became an independent party. The KKP is led by Mehmet Baran.
